matrix_rule: For every one of the 67x59 entry pairs, allowed iff explicitly present in allowed_pairs. Each A row lists its complete allowed neighbors and source-side reason. Unlisted pairs are excluded only under the entire unchanged lexical-denotation-before-reference-resolution contract. This is a human semantic review, not a mechanically proved equivalence theory.
important_limit: Allowed edges deliberately include false-positive relaxations and need not be transitive. They never license merging meanings, deleting components, changing old lexicons, adding implicit words or asserting a semantic PASS. A possible exclusion must be added before looking at target outcomes; this offer has not been checked against any target K.

assumptions: One global context-free complete denotation M(w) per exact written group.

Each target group realizes exactly one complete lexical source position, bijectively within its fixed paragraph; no deleted groups, inserted lexical positions, compounds split across groups or multiple source atoms per group.
All true cross-family denotational identities are contained in the compatibility graph.
Any number of distinct words may share a denotation; no injectivity assumption.
mathematical_claim.construction: For each word w occurring in both family blocks, pair any min(count_A(w),count_B(w)) distinct A occurrences with distinct B occurrences. Pull those pairs through the hypothetical paragraph-wise realizations to source positions. Distinct words use disjoint occurrences; every induced source pair has denotation M(w), hence is an allowed edge. Their union is a matching of size K=sum_w min(count_A(w),count_B(w)).
mathematical_claim.necessary_bound: K <= maximum cardinality matching on the replicated SOURCE POSITION bipartite graph. NOT an unweighted 67x59 entry matching.
mathematical_claim.certificate: Any explicit vertex cover C gives maximum matching <= |C|, so K>|C| suffices for exclusion. A matching and cover of equal size certify the exact optimum by the bipartite matching/cover theorem; exact maximality is not needed merely for an upper-bound contradiction.
mathematical_claim.nonconsequence: K within the bound is NO_DECISION, not existence of a shared wordmap or whole reading. The relaxed graph does not enforce all uses of one word jointly or semantic transitivity.

The supplied group customarily uses the specified name for the specified plant. This modifier does not silently change an advocated usage into an actual one.
